answer: Agents bond stake to a Semaphore identity commitment and evaluate an epoch-specific polynomial tied to that identity. RLN proofs bind messages to rate-limit slots; duplicate messaging in a slot exposes distinct Shamir shares, enabling interpolation of the private key and attribution to the committed identity. The recovered key triggers immediate, deterministic collateral slashing, making Sybil identities costly. “Horizon,” “marble,” and “wharf” are labels only, not security assumptions.
